traceability.notes: Story 010.0-DEV-DEEP-VALIDATION is fully implemented via the traceability/valid-req-reference rule and its helpers. The implementation parses markdown story files for REQ-*-style identifiers, validates @req and @supports annotations against those requirements, enforces safe and in-project story paths, caches parsed requirements for reuse during a lint run, and reports clear, specific errors when requirements are missing or paths are invalid. Comprehensive unit tests (tests/rules/valid-req-reference.test.ts) and real markdown fixtures demonstrate correct behavior for standard stories, bullet-list formats, and multi-story @supports usage, and all tests pass in the project’s Jest suite. The rule’s behavior and usage are documented in docs/rules/valid-req-reference.md with concrete examples. Together, this satisfies all acceptance criteria and the functional requirements described in docs/stories/010.0-DEV-DEEP-VALIDATION.story.md.
